India Today found that this photo of Rashmika Mandanna was edited. While Mandanna's leg was injured last month, it was not a life-threatening injury.Â
A reverse image search on Yandex led us to an August 2024 report in the Daily Mail about brain tumour surgery of English television and radio presenter Nicki Chapman. The report carried the original photo showing Chapman lying in the hospital bed. Chapman's face was replaced with Mandanna's in the viral image.
The article noted how Chapman dealt with the brain tumour with full strength and motivation, as told by her in an interview. She also shared the original image on Facebook on January 9. Apart from this, the photos of Allu Arjun , Mahesh Babu , and Vijay Devarakonda in the viral post were taken at the last rites of Telugu veteran actor-filmmaker Krishna, Mahesh Babu's father. Additionally, Rashmika Mandanna on January 11 shared photos of her injured leg and wrote that she injured herself in the gym and hoped to recover in the coming weeks or months.     View this post on Instagram            A post shared by Rashmika Mandanna (@rashmika_mandanna) Thus, we conclude that the claim regarding Rashmika Mandanna's health condition is untrue. - Ends Published By: Poorva Joshi Published On: Feb 4, 2025 22:20 IST

title: Fact Check: The curse of fame! Viral Mahakumbh girl Monalisa a victim of deepfakes
content:
All three videos are deepfakes. The original videos were shared by an influencer and a model.
The story of Monalisa Bhonsle from Madhya Pradesh's Khargone is an extraordinary one. First discovered as a garland seller at the Mahakumbh, her striking features made her a talking point on social media. And now, she has even reportedly been signed for a Bollywood movie . But all hasn't been smooth sailing for Monalisa. She was harassed by men at the Mahakumbh. And now she's the subject of several deepfakes.Â
In one video , Monalisa can be seen dancing in a red outfit to the famous Bollywood number "Sharara" by a river surrounded by mountains. In another video shot on a sea beach, Monalisa can be seen dancing in a black outfit.Â
In a third video , Monalisa can be in a blue saree. Outlets like The Times of India and Bollywood Life used screenshots from this video in several stories.
All these videos are deepfakes. Let's break them down.Â
A closer look revealed a similarity in all these clips: the watermark of an Instagram account called "NI8.OUT9". We checked the Instagram account in question and found it had been sharing these videos regularly. The first  and the third videos were shared on January 28 and the second one was shared on January 29.
While all the Hindi captions for all three videos mentioned the girl was Monalisa or her look-alike, a disclaimer in English noted that these videos were "created using face swap technology for entertainment purposes only."
Reverse-searching keyframes from each of these videos led us to the original clips, uploaded by social media influencers and fashion models. The first video was originally shared by a social media influencer named Tanu Rawat on December 11, 2024. A comparison between this clip and the viral video makes it clear that Tanu's face was swapped with Monalisa's.
The second video, where Monalisa can be seen dancing on a beach in a black outfit, was also originally shared by Tanu Rawat on October 14, 2024.     View this post on Instagram            A post shared by TANU RAWAT🔥 (@tanurawat33)
A post shared by TANU RAWAT🔥 (@tanurawat33)
A comparison between two identical frames from both videos shows that not only was her face swapped, but the video was also laterally inverted.
A reverse-search of keyframes from the third video led us to the Facebook page of a model named Thurgax, which led to her Instagram account. There, she shared the original clip on May 29, 2024. She gave credit for the visuals to another account called Filmakerparis. As per their bio, Thurgax is based out of France. A comparison of both the edited and original frame makes it clear that this video, too, was inverted after swapping the face of the model with Monalisa's.
Thus, it's clear all three videos are deepfakes. - Ends Published By: Anuja Jha Published On: Feb 6, 2025 20:17 IST

title: Fact Check: Playful interaction between Brazilian father-daughter VIRAL as indecent act at Indian school
content:
This video is from Brazil. It shows a playful interaction between a man and his daughter.
Recently, a government school principal and a female teacher were suspended  in Rajasthan's Chittorgarh district after a video of them engaging in sexual acts went viral.
Now, another CCTV video featuring a man and a girl in an office has now gone viral on social media. It shows the man playfully hugging the girl, patting her forehead, and kissing her cheeks.Â
Those sharing the video claimed it was from a Kendriya Vidyalaya in India, and demanded that appropriate action be taken against both. The archive of one such post  can be seen here .Â
However, India Today Fact Check found that the video in question is not from India at all but from Brazil. The man in the video confirmed that it was not leaked footage but a video he made with his daughter that was being shared with inappropriate claims.Â
We noticed that an X user @Edinho_Neves responded to a viral post featuring the video saying that it showed him with his 12-year-old daughter. In the post, he also requested the person who shared the video to remove the inappropriate caption. This account @Edinho_Neves belongs to a person named Eder Neves who lives in Brazil.  We then found that Eder had posted a longer version of the viral video on his Instagram account on December 13, 2024.  Alongside the video, he wrote, "Relax, everyone! That adorable girl in the video is my DAUGHTER!  Just a playful dad sharing kisses, hugs, and a gentle fall (totally safe, I promise). Pure LOVE and fun between father and daughter!" Its archive can be seen here . We contacted Eder through Instagram who confirmed to India Today Fact Check that the video shows him and her daughter. Thus, it's clear that a video from Brazil is being falsely shared as intimate moments of a man and a woman in an Indian school. - Ends Published By: Sahil Sinha Published On: Feb 8, 2025 15:46 IST

title: Fact Check: Diljit praised UP administration for his show in Lucknow, not Maha Kumbh arrangements
content:
Diljit did praise the UP administration, for his concert arrangements not Maha Kumbh.
Several cities in Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh are facing massive traffic jams  due to the heavy footfall of pilgrims at Prayagraj's Maha Kumbh. Amid this, has Punjabi singer Diljit Dosanjh praised the UP government for the Maha Kumbh arrangements? A video clip  featuring Dosanjh speaking about the UP administration in Punjabi is being shared with this claim.
The text within the video reads in Hindi, "CM Yogi's arrangements win Diljit's heart." An X user , while sharing the viral clip, wrote, "What happened to Diljit? Now he's praising CM Yogi ji for Mahakumbh arrangements."
India Today Fact Check found that the viral video has been edited to mislead that he was talking about Mahakumbh arrangements. While Diljit did praise the UP administration, it was about his concert in Lucknow in November 2024. Our Investigation
Had Diljit made any statement about Mahakumbh, it would have been widely reported. However, we did not find any credible news reports about this.
In the viral clip, Diljit Dosanjh speaks about a tour in Lucknow and then praises the administration. This suggested that the video might not be about Mahakumbh.
A reverse image search led us to a Threads post  containing a longer version of the viral clip. According to its caption, Diljit had thanked the UP and Ludhiana administrations for arrangements during his "Dil-Luminati" tour last year.
In the video posted on Threads, Diljit says, "The best arrangements were in UP and Ludhiana." He then mentions being apprehensive before his Lucknow show and thanks the administration. He says, "The best arrangement was in UP, thank you UP's government and Ludhiana's." The portion where Diljit thanked the Ludhiana administration along with the UP administration has been removed in the viral clip.
We found that this video was posted on Diljit's official Instagram channel on February 9, 2025 . In the approximately 35-minute video, Diljit was responding to comments from his fans. At around the 18-minute mark, he responded to a user's comment requesting him to perform in Lucknow. In the complete video, Diljit talks to his team member, then faces the camera and talks about his Lucknow show. The viral clip is taken from this section of the video. The complete section can be seen below.
In the complete 35-minute video, Diljit answered many questions but did not speak about the ongoing Mahakumbh Mela in Prayagraj.     View this post on Instagram            A post shared by DILJIT DOSANJH (@diljitdosanjh)
A post shared by DILJIT DOSANJH (@diljitdosanjh)
Diljit performed in 10 Indian cities during his Dil-Luminati tour (October–December 2024). He performed at Lucknow's Ekana International Football Stadium on November 22, 2024. - Ends Published By: Poorva Joshi Published On: Feb 11, 2025 19:14 IST

title: Fact Check: This kid fears his mom more than the tiger? We tracked down the tiger to find out why
content:
This video is from Pakistan. This child is the nephew of social media influencer Nouman Hassan, and the tiger is their pet.
A video of a caged tiger grabbing the t-shirt of a minor child has gone viral  on social media in India. The child seemingly screams for help and pleads with the tiger to release his t-shirt so he doesn't get scolded by his mother. The tiger, however, keeps pulling his t-shirt across the metal net of the cage.
While some doubt the video's authenticity and claim it is edited, others are demanding the immediate arrest of the person who filmed it. Some are also condemning the person who shot the video, calling them insensitive.Â
An archived version of one such post can be seen here .
India Today found that this video is neither doctored nor from India. Pakistani social media influencer Nouman Hassan created it with his pet tiger and his nephew.Â
Scanning through the comments, we noticed that one X user Dr. Abdul Sattar Khan pointed out that this video is from Pakistan. He also added that this child's family owns many tigers and lions. Importing tigers, lions and other exotic animals with prior government permission is allowed in Pakistan.Â
We contacted Dr. Abdul Sattar who lives in Hyderabad for more details.  He told us that the video in question shows a tiger owned by Pakistani social media influencer Nouman Hassan.Â
Following the clue from Dr. Abdul, we found that the viral video was indeed shared on Nouman Hassan's YouTube channel. Nouman Hassan who lives in Islamabad and has about 11 million followers on YouTube, keeps on sharing playful videos with his pet tigers.
We found multiple videos on Nouman's social media accounts featuring the same child from the viral video interacting with lions and tigers. In one clip, the child is seen holding a tiger by its chain. This time, the tiger is not even behind a cage. Suddenly, the tiger grabs the child's shoe. The child laughs, playfully taps the tiger's face, and says again, "If it gets damaged, my mother will scold me."     View this post on Instagram            A post shared by Nouman Hassan (@nouman.hassan1)
A post shared by Nouman Hassan (@nouman.hassan1)
In another video, the child is seen riding the tiger so confidently as if it's a stuffed toy.     View this post on Instagram            A post shared by Nouman Hassan (@nouman.hassan1)
A post shared by Nouman Hassan (@nouman.hassan1)
We contacted Nouman, who told India Today that the video was filmed in Islamabad and features his nephew, Asad. "This video is scripted, and the tiger is our pet. I own 25 lions and tigers, which I imported from Africa. All these animals are kept on my breeding farm."
When asked about taming these animals, he added, "When you raise an animal from childhood, it naturally gets tamed. They recognise you and do not harm you. Sometimes we get scratched with their nails, but they have never tried to attack us."
According to a report by Hindustan Times , in Pakistan, it is quite easy to import exotic animals. Owning such animals, especially big cats, has become a symbol of wealth and power in Pakistan. - Ends Published By: Poorva Joshi Published On: Feb 11, 2025 19:50 IST

title: Fact Check: PM was NOT snubbed by Macron at Paris AI Summit, he co-chaired event
content:
Viral video is clipped. In the full video, PM Modi walked into the event with Macron himself, who also invited him to the stage with a hand-shake and a hug.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi embarked on a three-day visit to France  on February 10. During his visit, he attended the AI Action Summit, the 14th India-France CEO Forum in Paris, and inaugurated the second Indian consulate in France's Marseille. Then he is scheduled to leave for a two-day visit to the United States from France.
Amid this, a video from the Paris AI Summit held on February 11 went viral, with many alleging that French President Emmanuel Macron snubbed PM Modi at the global event.
The video clip  suggested that while Macron shook hands with the Vice President of the United States, JD Vance, and greeted other leaders, he ignored PM Modi, who was sitting in the first row.
One person shared the video with the caption, "Wow Modi. Thanks for ensuring India is insulted on international forums. PM Modi tried multiple times to shake hands with French President Emmanuel Macron, but he was repeatedly ignored. The world respects India and its people, but due to his publicity stunts and incompetence, Modi is losing respect globally." Its archive can be seen here .
India Today Fact Check, however, found that Macron did not ignore PM Modi during the event. On the contrary, Modi walked into the event with Macron himself. Macron also invited him to the stage and greeted him with a handshake and a hug.
According to news reports , Prime Minister Narendra Modi co-chaired the AI Action Summit in Paris on February 11. The event commenced with a dinner hosted by President Macron on February 10 for global leaders attending the summit. On February 11, the AI summit began with PM Modi's address.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi also tweeted about the AI Action Summit in Paris, sharing photos of President Macron hugging and shaking hands with him at the event. The AI Action Summit in Paris is a commendable effort to bring together world leaders, policy makers, thinkers, innovators and youngsters to have meaningful conversations around AI. pic.twitter.com/kSXy0FhuIT — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) February 11, 2025

We then found a live stream of the summit, uploaded on the YouTube channel of the Associated Press on February 11. Few minutes into the video, as global leaders got seated, PM Modi and Macron can be seen walking into the event together .
The viral video portion can be seen at the timestamp of 9:45 sec . In it, Macron first shakes hands with JD Vance, and then greets Latvian President Edgars Rinkevics, sitting behind PM Modi. He then proceeds to greet other guests present at the summit.
Following this, Macron gave a brief address  and then invited PM Modi to the stage with a handshake and a hug. Modi then addressed the crowd.
Reports indicate that world leaders like United States Vice President JD Vance, Chinese Vice Premier Zhang Guoqing, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, and tech titans including Google CEO Sundar Pichai were present at the summit held at the Grand Palais. India and France co-chaired the event, where discussions were held about the impact of AI on jobs, governance, and society at large.Â
We also found Emmanuel Macron's tweet, dated February 11, featuring a video of him giving a warm welcome to Narendra Modi and JD Vance at a dinner, right before the summit. Welcome to Paris, my friend @NarendraModi ! Nice to meet you dear @VP Vance! Welcome to all our partners for the AI Action Summit. Let's get to work! pic.twitter.com/yatkrVYv9x — Emmanuel Macron (@EmmanuelMacron) February 10, 2025

Thus, it is clear that the viral video showed just a small portion of the event, misleading people. - Ends (Report: Deenadayal Kalarikkal) Published By: Sahil Sinha Published On: Feb 12, 2025 18:07 IST

title: Ranveer Allahbadia cries in guilt over 'obscene' remark? Old video shared as recent
content:
This video of Ranveer Allahbadia is not recent but from 2021, when he tested positive for COVID-19.
Famous YouTuber and podcaster Ranveer Allahbadia, aka "BeerBiceps" is facing backlash and legal action over his obscene remark in a standup comedy show called "India's Got Latent". The remark sparked widespread outrage, following which FIR was lodged against Ranveer Allahbadia , famous YouTuber Samay Raina, and influencer Apoorva Makhija among several others who attended the show.
Amid this, a video of Ranveer Allahbadia sobbing and saying that he feels guilty, is going viral on social media.Â
In the video, Allahbadia says, "I am feeling bad because all the work has been stopped because of me. I just feel damn guilty. The entire team was exposed to this…". He can also be seen using abusive language in the video.
Many on social media claimed that this was a recent video of Allahbadia, made by him after the controversy erupted. The video is viral on Facebook , Instagram and YouTube with the same claim. The archive of one such post can be seen here.
India Today found that this video of Ranveer Allahbadia is not recent but from 2021, when he tested positive for COVID-19.Â
A keyword search led us to a YouTube video of Ranveer Allahbadia, uploaded on his YouTube channel on April 7, 2021. The video is titled as "This Is NOT Clickbait - My Covid-19 Experience | Vlog 24".Â
The portion going viral can be seen after 30 seconds in the video. Here, Allahbadia tells his viewers how he had tested positive for COVID-19 and has to quarantine himself for 14 days, hampering his daily workflow. The eight-minute-long video also shows his team talking about the work they are doing in the absence of Allahbadia.Â
Thus, it is clear that the viral clip is almost four years old and has nothing to do with the recent controversy. However, after the backlash on social media, Allahbadia released a video apologising for his obscene remark in the show. - Ends Published By: Sayan Ganguly Published On: Feb 12, 2025 19:34 IST

title: Fact Check: Samay Raina DIDN'T abuse those asking for an apology, this video is from 2023
